What is Technical Screening?
Technical screening is the process of simultaneously testing and evaluating multiple technical candidates' skills and experiences against pre-decided parameters, using knowledge-based questions and application-based techniques. It is an ideal filtration process between receiving an application and hiring a candidate during technical recruitment.
